subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` expose metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or should external paths be filtered/restyled without raw filesystem stat calls?
rationale: The current patch crosses the established fs-safe containment boundary, while the user-facing bug can also be solved by filtering or UI semantics; automation cannot choose that security/product contract safely.

options.title: Keep fs-safe containment
options.body: Filter or restyle external transcript paths without raw stat metadata and preserve current preview denial semantics.

options.title: Accept external metadata
options.body: Allow existence/size/mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths only after explicit security acceptance and tests for symlink, directory, and outside-root behavior.

options.title: Split layout from backend
options.body: Rely on the already-merged layout fix and handle the backend Missing semantics in a narrow replacement PR.

recommendation.title: Keep fs-safe containment
recommendation.body: Filter or restyle external transcript paths without raw stat metadata and preserve current preview denial semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged the original workspace rail PR and is a good routing owner for the Gateway/security-boundary decision.
